notes: Independent/regional SELF-SERVICE yards with (or researched for) public online inventory. Statuses: adapter-built | candidate | blocked. Coordinates geocoded once via Nominatim (OSM) and hardcoded, matching the YARD_COORDS convention. Row52-embedded inventories are permanently out of scope (see INDEPENDENT_YARDS.md).

api.notes: Single unauthenticated GET returns entire multi-yard inventory (~11k vehicles, ~4.4 MB). Fields: yard(id), modelYear, make.name, model.name, vin, color, stockNumber, dateAdded(ISO), row.id (displayed as the row number on their site). robots.txt allows all.

api.requests_per_scan: ~50 (one per make, site=0 = all stores; 2s apart)
api.notes: POST action=doApiCall&apiAction=getVehicles&site=0&makes={Make}&models=0&years=0 returns all three stores' rows for that make as JSON. Per-make queries are required: with makes=0 the rows carry no make (Model is just 'MALIBU'/'CIVIC', except ~15% literal DB names like 'FORD F150 PICKUP'). Make list via apiAction=getMakes. Fields: Year, Model, Color, StockNumber, Row, DateSetData, Store, VIN, Odometer. robots.txt explicitly allows /wp-admin/admin-ajax.php.

api.requests_per_scan: ~45 (one per make with store=0), or 8 (one per store with makes=0, but the table has no Make column)
api.notes: Same WP plugin family as U-Pull-R (footable + 'glennForm' fingerprints; plugin dirs PnsV1_3.3 / gm_vehicle_search). action=getStores returns JSON store list; action=getVehicles&makes={Make}&models=0&store=0 returns an HTML table (Year/Model/Date/Row/Store/Color/Stock/VIN) across all stores. Vehicle photos hosted at app.pullnsaveapp.com (own app, not Row52) but photos are not captured per policy. robots.txt Crawl-delay: 10 - honor it, so a full scan is ~45 requests x 10s = ~8 min.

Entire inventory (~1,050 vehicles) is embedded server-side in table#alldata on the homepage; client JS only filters. Columns: Year, Make, Model, VIN, Color, Date, Row. Detroit metro (4.3M) - current MI coverage is a single yard. Need to confirm whether the table covers one or both of their Detroit locations before building.

api.requests_per_scan: ~1,600 pages unfiltered; per-branch/make filters exist and would cut this down
api.notes: 28 branches (AIM division): mostly Quebec/Ontario/Maritimes, plus US yards in ME (Bangor, Lewiston) and reportedly NY/VT/NH - US branches were NOT found in the main site branch list, so US inventory visibility is unverified. Paginated HTML archive is heavy (~19k vehicles at 12/page). Worth a follow-up to find branch-filtered queries and whether US yards publish inventory at all.

api.requests_per_scan: unknown - archive is location-gated ('Please select a location above')
api.notes: Florida self-service yards (Jacksonville, Tampa). Site loads static.crushsoftware.com/js/crush-web-form.js (CRUSH by S3 Software Solutions - car-buying form). Inventory archive requires a location query parameter not yet reverse-engineered; needs a follow-up session with browser devtools.

Single yard near Milwaukee (Sturtevant, WI). Dedicated inventory app with YEAR/MAKE/MODEL/STOCK/ROW/COLOR/ARRIVAL DATE table (plus /Home/Interchange and /Home/PartPrices routes). Small but easy; WI currently has one covered yard.
Jacksonville FL self-service yard. WP site with admin-ajax present but the inventory page path/mechanism was not identified in this pass.

PA yards (Hazleton, Allentown, Pennsburg) - big Northeast target (~22,500 vehicles/yr processed), but the site sits behind a Sucuri JavaScript challenge that blocks plain HTTP clients. Would require a headless browser; revisit only if policy allows.
Lincoln NE. Site returned HTTP 400 to polite plain-UA requests in this pass.
Large CA self-service chain (~10 yards). Domain unreachable during this pass (DNS/connection failure) - retry later, possibly under a different domain.
Idaho chain (Boise, Nampa, Caldwell, Twin Falls). Connection failed/empty response in this pass; retry later.
Merged into Pull-A-Part; upullandpay.com redirects to pullapart.com and the former UPAP yards (AZ/NM/CO) are already covered by the existing Pull-A-Part adapter.
